delete.description: Administrators delete regular users. Deleting an administrator needs the owner and a body with the owner's current `password`. The owner cannot be deleted.

204.description: User and data deleted; every session of the user has ended

400.description: Invalid input, an administrator deleting their own account this way, or the password is missing or wrong when deleting an administrator

403.description: Not an administrator, or deleting an administrator without being the owner

409.description: The owner account cannot be deleted

patch.description: Administrators update regular users. Changing a role, or changing an administrator or the owner, needs the owner; a role change also needs the owner's `currentPassword`. The owner cannot be demoted and the OWNER role cannot be assigned. A new password or role ends every session of that user, so it applies immediately. A new email address is marked unverified.

400.description: Invalid input (see `errors`), or `currentPassword` is missing or wrong for a role change

403.description: Not an administrator, or the change needs the owner

409.description: Username or email already taken, or the change would assign or remove the OWNER role

type.description:
Identifies the kind of error. `about:blank` for generic HTTP errors (malformed JSON, unsupported media type, ...), otherwise one of:

- `urn:problem:validation-failed`: The request body is invalid; the fields are listed in `errors`
- `urn:problem:invalid-sort`: The `sort` parameter names a property that cannot be sorted by
- `urn:problem:invalid-credentials`: Wrong username, email or password, or a refresh token that is missing, invalid, expired or already used
- `urn:problem:unauthenticated`: The access token is missing, invalid, expired or revoked
- `urn:problem:forbidden`: The caller is authenticated but lacks the required role
- `urn:problem:email-not-verified`: The email address must be verified before logging in
- `urn:problem:wrong-password`: The caller's current password, required to confirm the change, is missing or wrong
- `urn:problem:invalid-token`: The email verification or password reset token is unknown, used or expired
- `urn:problem:username-taken`: The username belongs to another account
- `urn:problem:email-taken`: The email address belongs to another account
- `urn:problem:owner-required`: Only the owner can change roles and manage administrators
- `urn:problem:owner-protected`: The owner account cannot be deleted or demoted, and the OWNER role cannot be assigned, through the API
- `urn:problem:own-account`: Administrators cannot delete their own account through the admin endpoint
- `urn:problem:user-not-found`: No user has this id
- `urn:problem:conflict`: The change conflicts with data written at the same time; retry it
- `urn:problem:login-locked`: Too many failed logins for this IP or account; wait for `Retry-After` seconds
- `urn:problem:rate-limited`: Too many requests from this IP; wait for `Retry-After` seconds
- `urn:problem:internal-error`: Unexpected server error; quote `X-Trace-Id` when reporting it
